facts.fact: N'Djamena's municipal authorities name the continued reliance on physical procedures, the volume of archives and the risk of document loss as the civil registry's key challenges at the launch of its digitisation project.

The municipality of N'Djamena launched a project on 23 September 2026 to digitise its civil registry and signed a memorandum with ANATS; an integrated management platform, modernised procedures and interconnection with the national identification system are planned, none yet reported in service.
The project is the municipality of N'Djamena's, under a memorandum with the state agency ANATS, with the OIF supporting it.
